purpose: Freeze the Hero Casting Law (영웅 율정/铸纹) template-to-level material progression from the pinned UnityDataTool parsed ConfigData snapshot. This catalog preserves source-defined template and level IDs and resolves only explicit GoodsType=6 item references; it does not infer Hero assignments.

relationContract.templateLevel: ConfigDataCastingLawTemplateInfo.CastingLawLevelUpInfoList[] -> ConfigDataCastingLawLevelUpInfo.ID by explicit numeric equality in source order
relationContract.item: LevelupMaterialsCost[].GoodsType == 6: Id -> ConfigDataItemInfo.ID by explicit numeric equality

frozenSnapshotExpectations.postLevel5CommonMaterialMeaning: All level 6-10 material references in the pinned snapshot resolve only to these three Item IDs. Counts remain template/level-specific and are not normalized.

normalizationRules: Preserve Template ID, Name, EquipmentType when present, Icon, and CastingLawLevelUpInfoList source order.
Require exactly ten level-info IDs per template in the pinned snapshot and map list position 1..10 to display level 1..10 without ID arithmetic.
Resolve every level-info ID only by explicit equality to ConfigDataCastingLawLevelUpInfo.ID.
Preserve LevelUpGoldCost, property fields, PreCastingLawLevelID, and LevelupMaterialsCost source values.
Resolve material items only when GoodsType is exactly 6 and only by explicit numeric equality to ConfigDataItemInfo.ID.
Do not derive Hero-to-template assignments from equipment icons, Hero names, display order, screenshot order, filename similarity, or ID arithmetic.
Do not treat the existing centralDiscipline release state as a proxy for Casting Law template availability.
Fail closed on duplicate IDs, missing level rows, malformed Goods records, missing item rows, broken predecessor chains, or generated/source mismatch.

PASS: 50 source templates resolve to 500 ordered level records with zero missing or duplicate IDs.
Every template level preserves the source predecessor chain and exact material list.
Every material is GoodsType 6 with a positive ID/count and resolves exactly once to ConfigDataItemInfo.ID.
All level 6-10 material IDs are exactly the frozen common set 3308, 3309, 3310 across the catalog.
Generated item snapshots match ConfigDataItemInfo exactly for the selected fields.
FAIL: Any source identity, ordering, predecessor, material, item, count, or parity mismatch occurs.

completionRule: Run the producer against the current pinned ConfigData source-pack, then run the independent validator. Completion requires generated PASS, summary PASS, validator PASS, the frozen 50/500 coverage, post-level-5 common-item parity, and no unexpected repository mutation.
